config.mod-enabled.name: Enable mod
config.mod-enabled.tooltip: Turns all mod features on or off.
config.workers-enabled.name: Enable workers
config.workers-enabled.tooltip: Allow greenhouse workers to emerge from Junimatic portals.
config.unlock.name: Unlock requirement
config.unlock.tooltip: Junimatic quest required before workers appear: Crops, Animals, Mining, Fishing, Forestry, IndoorPots, or Always.
config.junimo-speed.name: Junimo speed
config.junimo-speed.tooltip: Movement speed of greenhouse junimos (default is 3).
config.allow-all-locations.name: Junimos work any indoors
config.allow-all-locations.tooltip: Normally Junimos only work in the greenhouse. Turning this on allows Junimo portals to work in any indoor location with tilled soil. Does not work outdoors.
config.plant-seeds.name: Plant seeds
config.plant-seeds.tooltip: Plant the most expensive seed from a chest into empty tilled soil.
config.water-crops.name: Water crops
config.water-crops.tooltip: Water planted soil that still needs water.
config.fertilize-soil.name: Fertilize soil
config.fertilize-soil.tooltip: Apply the most expensive fertilizer from a chest to tilled soil that can accept it, including right after planting.
config.harvest-crops.name: Harvest crops
config.harvest-crops.tooltip: Harvest ready crops back into a chest.
config.water-after-planting.name: Water after planting
config.water-after-planting.tooltip: Water a seedling immediately instead of on a later trip.
config.bulk-carry.name: Bulk carry
config.bulk-carry.tooltip: When enabled, junimo takes as many seeds/fertilizers as needed for pending work in one chest visit. (enabled by default)
config.allow-shipping.name: Allow shipping
config.allow-shipping.tooltip: When enabled, harvested goods are shipped to a mini shipping bin in the network instead of deposited in chests.
config.verbose-logging.name: Verbose logging
config.verbose-logging.tooltip: Log detailed worker activity to the SMAPI console.
config.show-path-debug.name: Show path debug
config.show-path-debug.tooltip: Draw walkable tiles, soil access points, chests, and the junimo's planned route when in the greenhouse.
config.show-task-bubbles.name: Show task bubbles
config.show-task-bubbles.tooltip: Draw a speech bubble above each worker with its current task.
config.never-drop-items.name: Never drop items
config.never-drop-items.tooltip: When a tile is already planted or destroyed, skip it and keep working instead of dropping carried items. Items are returned to the chest if no more work remains.
